headline: NVIDIA Risk Is Rising So These US Large Cap Stocks Look Worth A Closer Look
summary: Markets are increasingly tied to just a few giants, so a stumble in NVIDIA, Apple, or Microsoft could ripple through your index funds faster than many investors expect. That concentration risk also creates a window for stocks that are less dependent on the AI story or on mega-cap momentum. This article walks through three large-cap U.S. companies exposed to the same headlines, explaining where some investors see potential opportunity rather than fragility.
